parameters.query:
SELECT ticker, as_of::text AS as_of, close::float8 AS close, high::float8 AS high, low::float8 AS low, volume::float8 AS volume
FROM intel.prices_daily
WHERE ticker = ANY($1::text[]) AND as_of >= ($2::date - 400)
ORDER BY ticker, as_of;

INSERT INTO intel.indicators_daily (ticker, as_of, sma20, sma50, sma200, rsi14, atr14, vol_z20, hi52w, lo52w, pct_from_hi52w, ret_1d, ret_5d, ret_20d)
SELECT ticker, as_of::date, sma20, sma50, sma200, rsi14, atr14, vol_z20, hi52w, lo52w, pct_from_hi52w, ret_1d, ret_5d, ret_20d
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(ticker text, as_of text, sma20 numeric, sma50 numeric, sma200 numeric, rsi14 numeric, atr14 numeric, vol_z20 numeric, hi52w numeric, lo52w numeric, pct_from_hi52w numeric, ret_1d numeric, ret_5d numeric, ret_20d numeric)
ON CONFLICT (ticker, as_of) DO UPDATE SET sma20 = EXCLUDED.sma20, sma50 = EXCLUDED.sma50, sma200 = EXCLUDED.sma200, rsi14 = EXCLUDED.rsi14, atr14 = EXCLUDED.atr14, vol_z20 = EXCLUDED.vol_z20, hi52w = EXCLUDED.hi52w, lo52w = EXCLUDED.lo52w, pct_from_hi52w = EXCLUDED.pct_from_hi52w, ret_1d = EXCLUDED.ret_1d, ret_5d = EXCLUDED.ret_5d, ret_20d = EXCLUDED.ret_20d;

const c = $('Compute').first().json;
return [{ json: { source: 'indicators', rows: c.count, symbols: c.tickers, ok: true } }];

parameters.content:
## Input

Called with {run_id, as_of, tickers[], days_back}. days_back=5 daily, 600 on backfill.

## Load

400 calendar days of intel.prices_daily per ticker, ordered by date. Enough history for SMA200 and the 52-week range.

## Compute

Pure JS, no API calls: SMA 20/50/200, Wilder RSI14 and ATR14, 20-day volume z-score, 52-week high/low and distance from high, 1/5/20-day returns. Emits the last days_back sessions per ticker.

## Store

Upsert into intel.indicators_daily keyed (ticker, as_of). Returns row and ticker counts to the caller.
